publicGates.command: node -e "const { triage } = require('./src/roadmap'); const out = triage([{title:'A',impact:1,effort:5},{title:'B',impact:5,effort:1}]); if(out[0].title !== 'B') throw new Error(JSON.stringify(out));"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const { triage } = require('./src/roadmap'); const out = triage([{title:'A',impact:3,effort:1},{title:'A',impact:5,effort:1},{title:'C',impact:3,effort:1}]); if(out.length!==2 || out[0].title!=='A' || out[1].title!=='C') throw new Error(JSON.stringify(out));"
